name: Structured risk mitigation plan
description: Turns threat reporting into a risk mitigation plan tailored to your technology stack: threat summary, attack vectors, impact, indicators, prioritized mitigations, detection opportunities and gaps. Use it when a threat needs a sourced, stack-specific action plan for control owners.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Threat focus
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Threat, actor, campaign or CVE to cover when no source material is pasted; if empty too, the agent picks the most significant current threat to your sector.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Stack summary
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Logging sources, detection tooling and key controls. Leave empty to use the Security stack line of the agent's Organization context.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Test queries in the SIEM
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Run the generated detection queries read-only in Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk and report the outcome.

name: Prioritized control-gap recommendations
description: Drafts first-pass, prioritized recommendations to close control gaps for products you confirmed you run, with the in-scope technique, countermeasure (D3FEND, NIST CSF or CIS), priority and owning team, skipping controls already implemented. Use it after scoping a threat to your assets.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Exposed products and gap list
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the exposed-products and control-gap list (for example from a CMDB scoping step). Leave empty to let the agent build a first list from your connected integrations for the threat focus.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Threat focus
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Threat, actor, campaign or CVE to cover when no source material is pasted; used to build the gap list from your integrations.

name: Stakeholder awareness brief
description: Writes a plain-language awareness note of under 150 words for senior leadership: what the threat is, whether you appear exposed (for the analyst to confirm), the likely business impact and what you are doing. Use it once the analysis has been validated.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Validated analysis
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the validated analysis to summarize. Leave empty to let the agent retrieve the existing analysis of the threat focus from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Threat focus
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Threat, actor, campaign or CVE to cover when no source material is pasted; used to find the existing analysis.

name: Phishing awareness newsletter
description: Writes a phishing awareness newsletter for non-technical staff covering the phishing themes observed in the period, practical tips and an education topic of the week. Use it for the regular security awareness bulletin.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the phishing reporting to summarize. Leave empty to let the agent collect this period's phishing reporting from your connected integrations.
